findings.location: Opening paragraph and all references to the 3 p.m. and 6 p.m. schedule (opening; first visit rules; Zinnia’s later question)
findings.source_quote: “It was 2:30 p.m., Tuesday afternoon.” / “It’s not three o’clock yet.” / “arriving no earlier than three o’clock in the afternoon” / “leave by 6 p.m.” / “Is it three o’clock yet?”
findings.suggested_fix: Use Kiswahili clock expressions that preserve the source times: for example, “saa nane na nusu alasiri” for 2:30 p.m., “saa tisa alasiri” for 3 p.m., and “saa kumi na mbili jioni” for 6 p.m. Apply these consistently to the opening, dialogue, rules, and later question.
findings.translation_quote: “Ilikuwa saa 2:30 alasiri” / “Bado saa tatu hazijafika” / “wasifike kabla ya saa 3 alasiri” / “kabla ya saa 6 alasiri” / “Je, saa tatu zimefika?”
